hero.tagline: The Smart Way to Run Your Shop
hero.description: Smart-Curuza is the all-in-one POS, inventory & CRM system built for African traders. Works offline, syncs everywhere.
hero.badge: Offline-First • Mobile Ready • Built for Africa

howItWorks.title: Get Started in Minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps to transform your business
howItWorks.step1Desc: Create your account in under 2 minutes. Add your business name, location, and you're ready to go.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Scan barcodes or manually add inventory. Set prices, track batches, and monitor your stock levels.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Process sales, accept mobile money, manage credit customers, and watch your profits grow in real time.

features.title: Everything You Need to Run Your Business
features.subtitle: Powerful tools designed for the way you already work

pos.title: Point of Sale
pos.desc: Fast checkout with barcode scanning, multiple payment methods including Mobile Money, and automatic receipt printing.

inventory.title: Inventory & Yield Tracking
inventory.desc: Break bulk items, track batch profitability, get low-stock alerts, and know exactly how much profit each sack earns you.

crm.title: Customer & Debt Book
crm.desc: Digital 'Madeni' book to track credit sales, send SMS reminders, and build customer loyalty with points.

security.title: Device Security
security.desc: Built-in device management with kiosk mode, payment-linked auto-lock, and remote monitoring for financed devices.

benefits.title: Why Smart-Curuza?
benefits.subtitle: Built by Africans, for African businesses

offline.title: Works Offline
offline.desc: No internet? No problem. Sell without interruption and sync when you reconnect.

mobile.title: Mobile Money Ready
mobile.desc: Accept MTN & Airtel Mobile Money with instant STK Push confirmation.

sync.title: Real-Time Sync
sync.desc: Your data syncs across all devices — phone, POS terminal, and web dashboard.

language.title: Multi-Language
language.desc: Use the app in English or Kinyarwanda. More languages coming soon.

analytics.title: Business Intelligence
analytics.desc: Revenue charts, profit margins, and daily reports to make smarter decisions.

team.title: Team Management
team.desc: Add cashiers, manage shifts, and approve team logins from your phone.

testimonials.title: Loved by Merchants
